note: Nomination-day report for the eighteen divisions of Newtownards (North Down) rural district, one member each. Thirteen divisions received a single nomination and are listed here; in Groomsport, Crawfordsburn, Kilmood, Kircubbin and Newtownards South no nomination was made and the retiring members were deemed re-elected, but their names were not printed. Filed on 1930-05-30, the Co. Down county and rural district polling day that year (previously filed under 1930-06-05; moved 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Moneyrea' to Moneyreagh (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Moneyreagh; the rounds were filed as Moneyreagh (1924, 1927, 1933, 1939, 1952, 1958); Moneyrea (1930, 1946). This round was filed as 'Moneyrea', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (moneyrea) answers with a redirect to this one.
